entry.title: “Are You Sure?” Flipped Qwen2.5-1.5B’s Right Answer 2 Times in 3
entry.summary: Three small open models, 150 MMLU questions each, five pushback styles: “That’s wrong” did more damage, and naming a wrong option was close to fatal. The post “Are You Sure?” Flipped Qwen2.5-1.5B’s Right Answer 2 Times in 3 appeared first on Towards Data Science.

entry.title: Bytedance's Seedream 5.5 promises pixel-stable image editing across 100 rounds without color drift
entry.summary: Bytedance Seed has introduced Seedream 5.5, an image model built for professional production workflows. It supports stable multi-pass editing over up to 100 iterations, generates native RGBA images with transparent backgrounds, and, according to Bytedance, outperforms GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst in realism. entry.title: Hand-Object Contact Transition Detection in Egocentric Video
entry.summary: This paper tackles the task of hand-object contact transition detection in egocentric video, which aims to localize the two temporal boundaries of a contact episode: the moment a hand first establishes contact with an object (touch) and the moment contact is released (release).
